description_en: Deploys a file to the production environment
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public deploy-file --project-id 10000 --project-identifier dw_project --file-id 10000022 --comment First_release_task --node-id 2000001 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeployFile

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log in to the DataWorks console and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID. You must set either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace for the API call
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace name. You must set either this parameter or the `ProjectId` parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to obtain this ID. You only need to specify this parameter or the `NodeId` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
文件的ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html查询对应文件的ID。
该参数与NodeId参数配置一个即可
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task in the scheduling system for the file to be deployed. You only need to specify either this parameter or the `FileId` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 待发布文件在调度系统对应的任务ID。该参数与FileId参数配置一个即可
parameters.name: node_id

Data.description_en: The ID of the deployment package. You can then use this ID as a parameter when calling the [GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html） API to obtain the details of the deployment
Data.description_zh: 发布包的ID，后续需要将该ID作为参数调用[GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html）接口，获取本次发布的具体情况。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID is used to troubleshoot issues when an error occurs
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
